facts.claim: United Airlines suffered a system outage on Monday evening, November 16, grounding all departing mainline flights nationwide; flights already airborne and United Express flights were not affected.

The outage affected the airline's ability to calculate aircraft weight and balance, keeping aircraft at the gate and delaying thousands of passengers; the system has since been resolved and flights are able to depart, though delays were expected through the rest of the evening.

United confirmed there was no indication the outage was a cybersecurity issue, and a spokesperson said: "We have resolved a technology issue that delayed flight departures. While some flights were delayed, there was no impact on flights in progress, or on United Express flights. There is no indication that this was a cybersecurity-related issue."

The outage came three days after the FAA halted all departures to, from and within the United States because of discrepancies in radar data following an upgrade from copper to fiber-optic cabling by contractor L3Harris at a route site in El Dorado, Arkansas.
United is the world's largest airline by fleet size, carries more than 175 million passengers a year, and flies to more than 350 destinations.

zh.title: 聯合航空系統故障 全美主線航班停飛 問題已排除
zh.summary: 聯合航空11月16日週一晚間發生系統故障，導致全美主線出發航班全面停飛；已在空中的航班與聯合快運航班不受影響，問題隨後已排除，航班恢復出發。
body: 聯合航空11月16日週一晚間發生系統故障，導致全美主線出發航班全面停飛；已在空中的航班與聯合快運（United Express）航班不受影響。故障原因是系統無法計算飛機的重量與平衡，飛機因此滯留於登機門，數千名旅客行程延誤。問題隨後已排除，航班可恢復出發，但晚間仍可能出現延誤。

聯合航空表示，此次故障沒有跡象顯示與網路安全有關。航空公司發言人表示：「We have resolved a technology issue that delayed flight departures. While some flights were delayed, there was no impact on flights in progress, or on United Express flights. There is no indication that this was a cybersecurity-related issue.」
這起故障發生在美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）全國停飛事件三天後；當時因L3Harris在阿肯色州埃爾多拉多進行銅線改光纖工程後雷達資料出現差異，全美出發航班一度停飛。聯合航空是全球機隊規模最大的航空公司，每年載運逾1.75億人次，飛往逾350個目的地。

en.title: United Airlines system outage grounds mainline flights nationwide; issue resolved
en.summary: United Airlines suffered a system outage on Monday evening, November 16, grounding all departing mainline flights nationwide; flights already airborne and United Express services were unaffected, and the issue has since been resolved.
body: United Airlines suffered a system outage on Monday evening, November 16, grounding all departing mainline flights nationwide. Flights already airborne and those operated by United Express were not affected. The outage left the airline unable to calculate aircraft weight and balance, keeping aircraft at the gate and delaying thousands of passengers across the network. The system has since been resolved, and flights are able to depart, though delays were expected through the rest of the evening.

United confirmed there was no indication the outage was a cybersecurity issue. A spokesperson said: "We have resolved a technology issue that delayed flight departures. While some flights were delayed, there was no impact on flights in progress, or on United Express flights. There is no indication that this was a cybersecurity-related issue."

The outage came three days after the FAA halted all departures to, from and within the United States because of discrepancies in radar data following an upgrade from copper to fiber-optic cabling by contractor L3Harris at a route site in El Dorado, Arkansas. United, the world's largest airline by fleet size, carries more than 175 million passengers a year to more than 350 destinations.
